_comment: THE SECOND SATELLITE (sky world s4), and it exists to make the registry
carry more than one of a thing. One satellite proves an island can be added;
TWO prove the table generalises - that `the hub` is not quietly special and
that an unlock ladder has more than one rung. The step from one to two is the
interesting one; two to three is not, which is why there are two.
Same recipe as near_isle (models/island.gltf, the parametric satellite mesh)
and deliberately identical in geometry: what differs between these two is
their PRICE and their id, because that is what s4 is testing. Islands that
differ in shape are an authoring job, not a mechanism job.
NO ZONE, NO CAMERA, NO SUN, NO SKY - see near_isle and ADR-0142.
name: far_isle

entities._comment: The island. Casts nothing (nothing is underneath), tints nothing (a tint would replace the model's own material).
